title: A Salon on the Left Bank
text: Writers, painters, and exiles argue about art until dawn. Some of them have been to strange places.

pass.text: You make a friend who wants to help.

fail.text: A painter shows you his newest canvas. You wish he had not.

title: The Catacombs
text: Six million dead line the tunnels under the city. A society of collectors meets at the deepest point.

pass.text: The collectors respect courage. They give you something from their vault.

fail.text: Your lamp goes out. You find the way back two days later.

title: A Bookstall on the Seine
text: Among the cheap novels, one battered book is handwritten. The seller does not know what it is.

then.text: It is a book of spells. Most of them are nonsense. One is not.

else.text: When you come back the next day, the stall is gone.

title: Rumors at the Opera
text: In the boxes at the opera, the rich and powerful gossip behind their fans.

pass.text: You overhear a banker and a bishop planning a midnight meeting.

fail.text: The tickets cost more than you expected.
